query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Stripe on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Stripe, 17 November 2026

**Window:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources are the search results provided; no other information was used.

## Deals

- Stripe's acquisition-related news in the results is thin. One report says the company agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced, 2026-11-15). **The excerpt does not name Stripe**, so confirm that this item concerns Stripe before relying on it.
- Reports in several outlets say Stripe and Advent International bid more than $53 billion for PayPal, framed as a stablecoin-and-wallets play. These are reports, not confirmed transactions (https://www.financexmagazine.com/post/stablecoins-storm-the-rails-swift-builds-a-blockchain-and-wero-hits-52-million-payments-just-had, 2026-11-09).
- Stripe's company profile lists OpenRouter, Inc. (7.50B USD, dated 2026-08-01), Clerky, Inc. (2026-08-01) and Valora, Inc. (2025-12-01). These fall outside the 30-day window, so treat them as background. The profile is undated (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/igPwhNOUwEGy).

## Launches and Product

- **Global Payouts wallet capability:** US businesses can send stablecoin payouts directly to crypto wallets in 160+ markets. It launched in public preview in early November 2026 (https://cryptonews.net/news/market/33703716, 2026-11-04).
- **Stablecoin prototype:** Stripe is reportedly building a stablecoin prototype that combines Bridge's issuance and settlement capabilities with its payments stack. The source attributes this to CoinGape. Bridge itself was acquired for $1.1B last year (https://www.financexmagazine.com/post/stablecoins-storm-the-rails-swift-builds-a-blockchain-and-wero-hits-52-million-payments-just-had, 2026-11-09).
- **Celo / MiniPay:** MiniPay's integration of Link by Stripe went live on 12 November, giving users in the EU and US a one-click fiat-to-stablecoin onramp. MiniPay has more than 20 million wallets (https://www.tradingview.com/news/coinmarketcal:ce753058b094b:0-celo-minipay-integrates-link-by-stripe-for-one-click-stablecoin-purchases-12-nov-2026, 2026-11-12).

## Hires

No hiring news was found in the results. Stripe's leadership changes should be checked separately before the meeting.

## Market Context

- AI assistants from Meta and others have recently been enabled to make purchases on cardholders' behalf, which banks are racing to address. The excerpt does not mention Stripe (https://www.wsj.com/finance/ai-bots-are-using-credit-cards-banks-are-racing-to-keep-up-c30dda30, 2026-11-13).

## Excluded

Several results matched the name "Stripe" but concern other subjects, including a sports team, a university, and a fashion item. They were excluded.

## Open questions

1. **Globex:** Is Stripe the party in the reported $9.4 billion agreement, and if so, how does a pending acquisition affect partnership or roadmap commitments we discuss?
2. **Stablecoins and PayPal:** What is the timeline for the stablecoin prototype and Bridge integration, and what is Stripe's position on the reported PayPal bid?
3. **Global Payouts:** When does the wallet payout capability move from public preview to general availability, and which markets are next after the 160+ currently covered?
